chunks: Al-Amraki narrated through his chain, saying: Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) said:

Verily, four thousand angels establish prayers next to the grave of Al-Husayn (peace be upon him) from the rising of dawn until the sun sets. Then they ascend, and an equal number descend, and they pray until the rising of dawn. Therefore, it is not fitting for a Muslim to delay visiting his grave for more than four years.
ai.seo_question: How long can a Muslim delay visiting the grave of Imam Al-Husayn (a.s.)?
ai.summary: Imam Al-Sadiq (a.s.) highlights the celestial honor of Imam Al-Husayn’s (a.s.) shrine by noting that four thousand angels pray there continuously, dividing their shifts between day and night. This continuous divine worship underscores the grave's status as a focal point of spiritual connection, reinforcing the scholarly consensus that delaying Ziyarah for more than four years is discouraged for both the wealthy and the poor.
